heading: FAQ’s on Real Estate App Development Solutions

items.question: Can the app be customised?
items.answer: Yes. Branding, features and workflows can be tailored to your business.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A branded launch typically takes 6–8 weeks, depending on customisation and extra features.

items.question: Can agents upload their own listings?
items.answer: Yes. Agents can add and manage listings with photos, videos and details.

items.question: Does it support virtual tours?
items.answer: Yes. Photo galleries, video and virtual tours can be added.

items.question: Can I charge agents for listings?
items.answer: Yes. Subscriptions and featured listing fees are supported.

items.question: How much does a real estate app cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on features and platforms. Share your requirements for an estimate.
